summary: community.dns breaking changes: txt_character_encoding defaults to decimal instead of octal, inventory filters is now a separate option rather than an alias of simple_filters, the inventory plugin option is required, and lookup/lookup_as_dict search defaults to true.
questions: Why are my TXT records encoded differently after upgrading community.dns?
Is filters still an alias of simple_filters in DNS inventory plugins?
Do I need to set plugin: in community.dns inventory configs?
What is the new default for search in the community.dns lookup?

answer_card.title: community.dns breaking changes in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md:
- `txt_character_encoding` default changed from `octal` to `decimal`.
- Inventory plugins: `filters` is now its own option, not an alias of `simple_filters`. The `plugin` option is required.
- `lookup` / `lookup_as_dict`: `search` now defaults to `true`.
